author: ILLIA POLIANSKYI, Jaisocx Inc.
name: @jaisocx/ts_tools
description: Central conf files, package.json, node_modules for the entire typescript in the workspace

scripts.https: . ~/.bashrc; cd "${IN_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_VOLUME}/ts" && pwd; NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider; export NODE_OPTIONS;  node ./node_modules/http-server/bin/http-server -U -d -S -C "${ssl_cert_path}" -K "${private_key_path}" -p "${node_https_publish_port}" "${node_https_publish_folder}"
scripts.sites_tools_https: . ~/.bashrc; cd "${IN_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_VOLUME}/ts" && pwd; NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider; export NODE_OPTIONS;  node ./node_modules/http-server/bin/http-server -U -d -S -C "${ssl_cert_path}" -K "${private_key_path}" -p "${node_https_sites_tools_publish_port}" "${IN_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_VOLUME}/${TYPESCRIPT_PACKAGES}/${node_https_sites_tools_publish_rel_folder}"
